title: Antihypnotic
summary: ANTIHYPNOT'IC, adjective [Gr. sleep.] Counteracting sleep; tending to prevent sleep or lethargy. ANTIHYPNOT'IC, noun A medicine that prevents or tends to prevent sleep.
